title.zh: 卷四十八 志第一: 天文一
title.raw: 卷四十八 志第一: 天文一 Volume 48 Treatises 1: Astronomy 1

translations.literal: Astronomy One
translations.idiomatic: Astronomy I

sentences.zh: 司天之說尚矣，《易》曰：「天垂象，見吉凶，聖人象之。

translations.literal: The doctrine of overseeing Heaven is of long standing. The Changes says: "Heaven displays signs by which fortune and misfortune may be seen; the sage takes them as images."
translations.idiomatic: The doctrine of reading Heaven is ancient indeed. The Book of Changes says: "Heaven hangs forth its signs, revealing fortune and misfortune; the sage takes these as images."

translations.literal: " It also says: "Observe the patterns of Heaven to discern the changes of the seasons."
translations.idiomatic: " It also says: "Contemplate the patterns of Heaven to discern the changes of the seasons."

sentences.zh: 」自古有國家者，未有不致謹於斯者也。

translations.literal: " From antiquity, those who possessed states have none who failed to treat this matter with utmost care.
translations.idiomatic: " From antiquity onward, no state has failed to treat this matter with the utmost care.

sentences.zh: 是故堯命羲、和，歷象日月星辰，舜在璇璣、王衡，以齊七政，天文於是有測驗之器焉。

translations.literal: Therefore Yao appointed Xi and He to calculate and image the sun, moon, stars, and constellations; Shun sat at the armillary sphere and jade transparence to align the seven regulators—thus astronomy came to have instruments for measurement and verification.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Yao appointed Xi and He to calculate and chart the sun, moon, stars, and constellations; Shun sat at the armillary sphere and jade sight-tube to align the seven regulators—and so astronomy acquired instruments for measurement and testing.

sentences.zh: 然古之為其法者三家：曰周髀，曰宣夜，曰渾天。

translations.literal: Yet of old three schools established their methods: Zhou Bi, Xuan Ye, and Hun Tian.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in antiquity three schools devised methods for it: the Zhou Bi, the Xuan Ye, and the Hun Tian.

sentences.zh: 周髀、宣夜先絕，而渾天之學至秦亦無傳，漢洛下閎始得其術，作渾儀以測天。

translations.literal: Zhou Bi and Xuan Ye perished first; the learning of Hun Tian likewise found no transmission by the Qin. In Han times Luoxia Hong first recovered its techniques and made the armillary sphere to measure Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou Bi and Xuan Ye schools died out first, and the Hun Tian learning too had no transmission by the Qin. In Han times Luoxia Hong was the first to recover its techniques and made the armillary sphere to measure Heaven.

sentences.zh: 厥後歷世遞相沿襲，其有得有失，則由乎其人智術之淺深，未易遽數也。

translations.literal: Thereafter, passing through successive ages in continuous inheritance, whether there was gain or loss depended on the shallowness or depth of each person's wisdom and craft—not something easily reckoned in haste.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, passing through successive ages in continuous inheritance, whether there was gain or loss depended on the shallowness or depth of each person's wisdom and skill—not something easily reckoned at a stroke.

sentences.zh: 宋自靖康之亂，儀象之器盡歸於金。

translations.literal: After the turmoil of the Jingkang era, Song's astronomical instruments entirely passed to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: After the turmoil of the Jingkang era, the Song dynasty's astronomical instruments all passed to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 元興，定鼎於燕，其初襲用金舊，而規環不協，難復施用。

translations.literal: When the Yuan arose and established its capital at Yan, at first they continued Jin's old instruments, but their rings and graduations did not accord, and they were hard to put back into use.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yuan arose and established its capital at Yan, at first they continued to use the Jin's old instruments, but the rings and graduations did not accord, and they could scarcely be put back into service.

sentences.zh: 於是太史郭守敬者，出其所創簡儀、仰儀及諸儀表，皆臻於精妙，卓見絕識，蓋有古人所未及者。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Grand Astrologer Guo Shoujing produced the simplified armillary, upward-looking instrument, and various other instruments he had created—all reaching exquisite refinement, with outstanding insight and surpassing understanding, having what the ancients had not attained.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Grand Astrologer Guo Shoujing produced the simplified armillary, the upward-looking instrument, and his various other instruments—all of exquisite refinement, with insight and understanding surpassing the ancients.

sentences.zh: 其說以謂：昔人以管窺天，宿度余分約為太半少，未得其的。

translations.literal: His doctrine held that of old men used a tube to peer at Heaven; lodge degrees and fractional remainders were approximated as a little more than half too much, and the true mark was not obtained.
translations.idiomatic: His doctrine held that in former times men used a tube to peer at Heaven, approximating lodge degrees and fractional remainders as somewhat more than half a degree too much, without hitting the true mark.

sentences.zh: 乃用二線推測，於余分纖微皆有可考。

translations.literal: He then used two threads for measurement and inference, so that even the finest fractional remainders could all be verified.
translations.idiomatic: He then used paired sight-threads for measurement, so that even the finest fractional remainders could all be verified.

sentences.zh: 而又當時四海測景之所凡二十有七，東極高麗，西至滇池，南逾朱崖，北盡鐵勒，是亦古人之所未及為者也。

translations.literal: Moreover, at that time places for measuring shadows throughout the four seas numbered twenty-seven in all—east to the limit of Goryeo, west to Dian Pool, south beyond Zhuya, north to the end of Tiele—this too was what men of old had not accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, at that time there were twenty-seven stations throughout the realm for measuring shadows—east to Goryeo, west to Dian Pool, south beyond Zhuya, north to the limits of Tiele—which was also something the ancients had never accomplished.

sentences.zh: 自是八十年間，司天之官遵而用之，靡有差忒。

translations.literal: From this for eighty years the officials overseeing Heaven followed and used them, without any discrepancy.
translations.idiomatic: For eighty years thereafter, the officials of the celestial bureau followed and used them without any discrepancy.

sentences.zh: 而凡日月薄食、五緯淩犯、彗孛飛流、暈珥虹霓、精祲雲氣等事，其系於天文占候者，具有簡冊存焉。

translations.literal: As for all matters of solar and lunar eclipse, the five luminaries' encroachment and violation, comets and broom-stars and flying streams, halos and aureoles and rainbows, essences and vapors and cloud qi and the like that pertain to astronomical observation and divination—brief records of them are preserved.
translations.idiomatic: As for solar and lunar eclipses, encroachments of the five luminaries, comets and meteors, halos and rainbows, and other phenomena tied to astronomical observation—all are preserved in brief records.

sentences.zh: 若昔司馬遷作《天官書》，班固、范曄作《天文志》，其於星辰名號、分野次舍、推步候驗之際詳矣。

translations.literal: As when Sima Qian wrote the Treatise on the Celestial Offices, and Ban Gu and Fan Ye wrote Astronomical Treatises—in their treatment of star names and designations, territorial allotments and lodge positions, and calendrical calculation and verification they were thorough indeed.
translations.idiomatic: When Sima Qian wrote the Treatise on the Celestial Offices, and Ban Gu and Fan Ye wrote their Astronomical Treatises, their accounts of star names, territorial allotments, lodge positions, and calendrical calculation were thorough indeed.

sentences.zh: 及晉、隋二《志》，實唐李淳風撰，於夫二十八宿之躔度，二曜五緯之次舍，時日災祥之應，分野休咎之別，號極詳備，後有作者，無以尚之矣。

translations.literal: As for the two Treatises of Jin and Sui, they were in fact composed by Tang's Li Chunfeng—in the lodges' degrees of motion, the two luminaries' and five planets' positions, the responses of timely omens and calamities, and the distinctions of territorial fortune and misfortune—they were called extremely detailed and complete; later writers could not surpass them.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin and Sui Astronomical Treatises were in fact composed by the Tang scholar Li Chunfeng. In their treatment of the twenty-eight lodges' degrees of motion, the two luminaries' and five planets' positions, timely omens and calamities, and territorial fortune and misfortune, they were unsurpassed in detail; later writers could not improve upon them.

sentences.zh: 是以歐陽修誌《唐書·天文》，先述法象之具，次紀日月食、五星淩犯及星變之異；

translations.literal: Therefore Ouyang Xiu compiled the Astronomical Treatise of the Book of Tang, first describing the instruments of celestial pattern, then recording solar and lunar eclipses, the five stars' encroachments and violations, and stellar anomalies;
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Ouyang Xiu compiled the Astronomical Treatise of the Book of Tang, first describing the celestial instruments, then recording solar and lunar eclipses, encroachments of the five stars, and stellar anomalies;

sentences.zh: 而凡前史所已載者，皆略不復道。

translations.literal: as for all that earlier histories had already recorded, he briefly did not repeat them.
translations.idiomatic: and for all that earlier histories had already recorded, he omitted repetition entirely.

sentences.zh: 而近代史官誌宋《天文》者，則首載儀象諸篇；

translations.literal: Yet the recent historians who compiled the Song Astronomical Treatise first recorded the chapters on instruments and images;
translations.idiomatic: The recent historians who compiled the Song Astronomical Treatise, by contrast, opened with chapters on astronomical instruments;

sentences.zh: 誌金《天文》者，則唯錄日月五星之變。

translations.literal: those who compiled the Jin Astronomical Treatise recorded only the changes of sun, moon, and five stars.
translations.idiomatic: while those who compiled the Jin Astronomical Treatise recorded only the changes of the sun, moon, and five stars.

sentences.zh: 誠以璣衡之制載於《書》，日星、風雨、霜雹、雷霆之災異載於《春秋》，慎而書之，非史氏之法當然，固所以求合於聖人之經者也。

translations.literal: Truly because the armillary sphere's construction is recorded in the Documents, and the calamities and anomalies of sun and stars, wind and rain, frost and hail, and thunder are recorded in the Spring and Autumn—to write them with care is not merely the historian's method as such, but fundamentally to seek accord with the sage's classics.
translations.idiomatic: Truly, because the armillary sphere's construction is recorded in the Documents, and the calamities of sun and stars, wind and rain, frost and hail, and thunder are recorded in the Spring and Autumn Annals—to record them with care is not merely conventional historiography, but a deliberate effort to align with the sage's classics.

sentences.zh: 今故據其事例，作元《天文志》。

translations.literal: Now therefore, according to these precedents, we compose the Yuan Astronomical Treatise.
translations.idiomatic: We therefore follow these precedents in composing the Yuan Astronomical Treatise.

translations.literal: ○ Simplified Armillary
translations.idiomatic: ○ The Simplified Armillary

sentences.zh: 簡儀之制，四方為趺，縱一丈八尺，三分去一以為廣。

translations.literal: The construction of the simplified armillary: on four sides is the pedestal, one zhang eight chi in length, with one-third removed to make the width.
translations.idiomatic: The simplified armillary is built upon a square pedestal one zhang eight chi long, its width being two-thirds of that length.

sentences.zh: 趺面上廣六寸，下廣八寸，厚如上廣。

translations.literal: On the pedestal's upper surface the width is six cun, below eight cun, the thickness equal to the upper width.
translations.idiomatic: The pedestal's upper surface is six cun wide, its lower edge eight cun, and its thickness equal to the upper width.

translations.literal: In the center are laid three transverse sight-lines and three longitudinal sight-lines.
translations.idiomatic: Three transverse and three longitudinal sight-lines are laid across its center.

translations.literal: Two to the south, north reaching the southern sight-line;
translations.idiomatic: Two run southward, their northern ends reaching the southern sight-line;

translations.literal: one to the north, south reaching the central sight-line.
translations.idiomatic: one runs northward, its southern end reaching the central sight-line.

sentences.zh: 趺面四周為水渠，深一寸，廣加五分。

translations.literal: Around the four sides of the pedestal surface is a water channel, one cun deep, the width increased by five fen.
translations.idiomatic: A water channel one cun deep and five fen wider encircles the pedestal surface on all four sides.

sentences.zh: 四隅為礎，出趺面內外各二寸。

translations.literal: At the four corners are foundation blocks, projecting two cun inside and outside the pedestal surface.
translations.idiomatic: Foundation blocks at the four corners project two cun inside and outside the pedestal surface.

sentences.zh: 繞礎為渠，深廣皆一寸，與四周渠相灌通。

translations.literal: Around the foundations are channels, each one cun deep and wide, communicating with the channel on all four sides.
translations.idiomatic: Channels one cun deep and wide run around the foundations, connecting with the encircling channel on all four sides.

sentences.zh: 又為礎於卯酉位，廣加四維，長加廣三之二，水渠亦如之。

translations.literal: Further, foundations are made at the mao and you positions; the width is increased at the four intermediate directions, the length increased to two-thirds more than the width, and the water channels are likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Additional foundations are placed at the mao and you positions, wider at the four intermediate directions and longer by two-thirds of the width, with water channels constructed in the same manner.

sentences.zh: 北極雲架柱二，徑四寸，長一丈二尺八寸。

translations.literal: Two cloud-frame pillars for the north pole, four cun in diameter, one zhang two chi eight cun in length.
translations.idiomatic: Two cloud-frame pillars for the north pole, four cun in diameter and one zhang two chi eight cun long.

sentences.zh: 下為鰲雲，植於乾艮二隅礎上，左右內向，其勢斜準赤道，合貫上規。

translations.literal: Below are tortoise-clouds, planted on the foundations at the qian and gen corners; left and right face inward, their inclination aligning with the equator, jointly piercing the upper ring.
translations.idiomatic: Their bases take the form of tortoise-clouds, set on the foundations at the qian and gen corners, facing inward on left and right, inclined to align with the equator and jointly piercing the upper ring.

sentences.zh: 規環徑二尺四寸，廣一寸五分，厚倍之。

translations.literal: The ring's diameter is two chi four cun, width one cun five fen, thickness double that.
translations.idiomatic: The ring is two chi four cun in diameter, one cun five fen wide, and twice that in thickness.

sentences.zh: 中為距，相交為斜十字，廣厚如規。

translations.literal: In the center is a crosspiece, intersecting as a diagonal cross, width and thickness like the ring.
translations.idiomatic: A crosspiece at the center intersects as a diagonal cross, matching the ring in width and thickness.

sentences.zh: 中心為竅，上廣五分，方一寸有半，下二寸五分，方一寸，以受北極樞軸。

translations.literal: At the center is an aperture: above five fen wide, square one and a half cun; below two cun five fen, square one cun—to receive the north polar pivot shaft.
translations.idiomatic: At its center is an aperture—five fen wide and one and a half cun square above, two cun five fen deep and one cun square below—to receive the north polar pivot shaft.

sentences.zh: 自雲架柱斜上，去趺面七尺二寸，為橫光。

translations.literal: From the cloud-frame pillar slanting upward, seven chi two cun from the pedestal surface, is the transverse sight-line.
translations.idiomatic: Seven chi two cun above the pedestal surface along the slanting cloud-frame pillar is the transverse sight-line.

sentences.zh: 自光心上至竅心六尺八寸。

translations.literal: From the sight-line's center to the aperture's center is six chi eight cun.
translations.idiomatic: From the sight-line's center to the aperture's center is six chi eight cun.

sentences.zh: 又為龍柱二，植於卯酉礎中分之北，皆飾以龍，下為山形，北向斜植，以柱北架。

translations.literal: Further, two dragon pillars are made, planted north of the center division of the mao-you foundations, all ornamented with dragons; below in mountain shape, planted slanting northward, to support the northern frame.
translations.idiomatic: Two dragon pillars are also set north of the midpoint of the mao-you foundations, ornamented with dragons and shaped like mountains at their bases, planted slanting northward to support the northern frame.

sentences.zh: 南極雲架柱二，植於卯酉礎中分之南，廣厚形制，一如北架。

translations.literal: Two cloud-frame pillars for the south pole, planted south of the center division of the mao-you foundations, width, thickness, and form identical to the northern frame.
translations.idiomatic: Two cloud-frame pillars for the south pole are set south of the midpoint of the mao-you foundations, identical in width, thickness, and form to the northern frame.

sentences.zh: 斜向坤巽二隅，相交為十字，其上與百刻環邊齊，在辰巳、未申之間，南傾之勢準赤道，各長一丈一尺五寸。

translations.literal: Slanting toward the kun and xun corners, intersecting as a cross; above level with the edge of the hundred-mark ring, between chen-si and wei-shen, the southern inclination aligning with the equator, each one zhang one chi five cun long.
translations.idiomatic: They slant toward the kun and xun corners and intersect as a cross, their upper ends level with the hundred-mark ring between chen-si and wei-shen, inclined southward to align with the equator, each one zhang one chi five cun long.

sentences.zh: 自趺面斜上三尺八寸為橫光，以承百刻環。

translations.literal: From the pedestal surface slanting upward three chi eight cun is the transverse sight-line, to support the hundred-mark ring.
translations.idiomatic: Three chi eight cun above the pedestal surface along the slant is the transverse sight-line, which supports the hundred-mark ring.

sentences.zh: 下邊又為龍柱二，植於坤巽二隅礎上，北向斜柱，其端形制，一如北柱。

translations.literal: Below, two more dragon pillars are made, planted on the foundations at the kun and xun corners, slanting pillars facing north; their ends' form and construction are identical to the northern pillars.
translations.idiomatic: Below, two more dragon pillars are set on the foundations at the kun and xun corners, slanting northward, their upper ends matching the northern pillars in form.

sentences.zh: 四遊變環，徑六尺，廣二寸，厚一寸，中間相離一寸，相連於子午卯酉。

translations.literal: The four-tour rotating ring: diameter six chi, width two cun, thickness one cun; in the center separated by one cun, connected at zi-wu and mao-you.
translations.idiomatic: The four-tour rotating ring is six chi in diameter, two cun wide and one cun thick, with a one-cun gap at the center, connected at the zi-wu and mao-you positions.

sentences.zh: 當子午為圓竅，以受南北極樞軸。

translations.literal: At zi-wu are round apertures to receive the north and south polar pivot shafts.
translations.idiomatic: Round apertures at zi-wu receive the north and south polar pivot shafts.

sentences.zh: 兩面皆列周天度分，起南極，抵北極，余分附於北極。

translations.literal: On both faces are arrayed the degrees and minutes of the full circuit of Heaven, starting from the south pole, reaching the north pole, fractional remainders attached at the north pole.
translations.idiomatic: Both faces are graduated with the degrees and minutes of the full circuit of Heaven, from the south pole to the north pole, with fractional remainders marked at the north pole.

sentences.zh: 去南北樞竅兩旁四寸，各為直距，廣厚如環。

translations.literal: Four cun to either side of the north and south polar pivot apertures, each has a straight crosspiece, width and thickness like the ring.
translations.idiomatic: Four cun to either side of the north and south polar apertures, straight crosspieces matching the ring in width and thickness are set.

sentences.zh: 距中心各為橫關，東西與兩距相連，廣厚亦如之。

translations.literal: At the center of each crosspiece is a transverse bar, east-west connecting with the two crosspieces, width and thickness likewise.
translations.idiomatic: At the center of each crosspiece a transverse bar runs east-west, connecting the two crosspieces and matching them in width and thickness.

sentences.zh: 關中心相連，厚三寸，為竅方八分，以受窺衡樞軸。

translations.literal: The bars' centers are connected, three cun thick, with an aperture square eight fen, to receive the sighting-rule pivot shaft.
translations.idiomatic: The bars' centers are joined in a piece three cun thick, with a square aperture eight fen across to receive the sighting-rule pivot shaft.

sentences.zh: 窺衡長五尺九寸四分，廣厚皆如環，中腰為圓竅，徑五分，以受樞軸。

translations.literal: The sighting rule is five chi nine cun four fen long, width and thickness all like the ring; at the waist is a round aperture, five fen in diameter, to receive the pivot shaft.
translations.idiomatic: The sighting rule is five chi nine cun four fen long, matching the ring in width and thickness, with a round aperture five fen in diameter at its waist to receive the pivot shaft.

sentences.zh: 衡兩端為圭首，以取中縮。

translations.literal: Both ends of the rule are jade-tablet heads, to take the central contraction.
translations.idiomatic: Both ends of the rule are shaped like jade-tablet heads to establish the central sight-line.

sentences.zh: 去圭首五分，各為側立橫耳，高二寸二分，廣如衡面，厚三分，中為圓竅，徑六分。

translations.literal: Five fen from the jade-tablet heads, each has a side-standing transverse ear, two cun two fen high, wide as the rule's face, three fen thick, with a round aperture in the center, six fen in diameter.
translations.idiomatic: Five fen from each jade-tablet head, a transverse ear stands on either side—two cun two fen high, as wide as the rule's face and three fen thick, with a round aperture six fen in diameter at its center.

sentences.zh: 其中心，上下一線界之，以知度分。

translations.literal: At its center, upper and lower lines bound it, to know degrees and minutes.
translations.idiomatic: At its center, upper and lower lines mark the boundary for reading degrees and minutes.

sentences.zh: 百刻環，徑六尺四寸，面廣二寸，周布十二時、百刻，每刻作三十六分，厚二寸，自半已上廣三寸。

translations.literal: The hundred-mark ring: diameter six chi four cun, face two cun wide, around distributed the twelve double-hours and hundred marks, each mark divided into thirty-six parts, two cun thick, from the halfway point upward three cun wide.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred-mark ring is six chi four cun in diameter and two cun wide on its face, graduated around its circumference with the twelve double-hours and hundred marks, each mark subdivided into thirty-six parts; it is two cun thick, widening to three cun above the midpoint.

sentences.zh: 又為十字距，皆所以承赤道環也。

translations.literal: Further, cross-shaped crosspieces are made—all to support the equatorial ring.
translations.idiomatic: Cross-shaped crosspieces are also made, all to support the equatorial ring.

sentences.zh: 百刻環內廣面臥施圓軸四，使赤道環旋轉無澀滯之患。

translations.literal: On the broad inner face of the hundred-mark ring four round axles are laid horizontally, so the equatorial ring may rotate without the trouble of sticking.
translations.idiomatic: Four round axles are laid horizontally on the broad inner face of the hundred-mark ring so the equatorial ring may rotate without sticking.

sentences.zh: 其環陷入南極架一寸，仍釘之。

translations.literal: The ring sinks one cun into the south polar frame and is still nailed in place.
translations.idiomatic: The ring sinks one cun into the south polar frame and is nailed fast.

sentences.zh: 赤道環徑廣厚皆如四遊，環面細刻列舍、周天度分。

translations.literal: The equatorial ring's diameter, width, and thickness are all like the four-tour ring; the ring's face is finely engraved with lodges and the degrees and minutes of the full circuit of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The equatorial ring matches the four-tour ring in diameter, width, and thickness, its face finely engraved with the lodges and the degrees and minutes of the full circuit of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 中為十字距，廣三寸，中空一寸，厚一寸。

translations.literal: In the center is a cross-shaped crosspiece, three cun wide, hollow one cun in the center, one cun thick.
translations.idiomatic: At its center is a cross-shaped crosspiece three cun wide, hollow one cun at the center and one cun thick.

sentences.zh: 當心為竅，竅徑一寸，以受南極樞軸。

translations.literal: At the center is an aperture, one cun in diameter, to receive the south polar pivot shaft.
translations.idiomatic: At the center is an aperture one cun in diameter to receive the south polar pivot shaft.

sentences.zh: 界衡二，各長五尺九寸四分，廣三寸。

translations.literal: Two boundary rules, each five chi nine cun four fen long, three cun wide.
translations.idiomatic: Two boundary rules, each five chi nine cun four fen long and three cun wide.

sentences.zh: 衡首斜剡五分，刻度分以對環面。

translations.literal: The rule heads are obliquely cut five fen, with degrees and minutes marked to face the ring surface.
translations.idiomatic: The rule heads are cut obliquely five fen deep and graduated in degrees and minutes to align with the ring surface.

sentences.zh: 中腰為竅，重置赤道環、南極樞軸。

translations.literal: At the waist is an aperture, again setting the equatorial ring and south polar pivot shaft.
translations.idiomatic: An aperture at the waist again receives the equatorial ring and south polar pivot shaft.

sentences.zh: 其上衡兩端，自長竅處邊至衡首底，厚倍之，取二衡運轉，皆著環面，而無低昂之失，且易得度分也。

translations.literal: On the upper rule, both ends from the edge at the long aperture to the rule head's base are double thickness—taking the two rules to rotate, all rest on the ring surface without error of rising or falling, and degrees and minutes are easily obtained.
translations.idiomatic: On the upper rule, both ends from the long aperture to the rule head are double thickness, so that when the two rules rotate they rest flush on the ring surface without rising or falling, and degrees and minutes are easily read.

sentences.zh: 二極樞軸皆以鋼鐵為之，長六寸，半為本，半為軸。

translations.literal: Both polar pivot shafts are made of steel and iron, six cun long—half as base, half as shaft.
translations.idiomatic: Both polar pivot shafts are made of steel, six cun long—half as base, half as shaft.

sentences.zh: 本之分寸一如上規距心，適取能容軸徑一寸。

translations.literal: The base's degrees and minutes are identical to the upper ring crosspiece's center, just enough to accommodate a shaft one cun in diameter.
translations.idiomatic: The base is graduated identically to the upper ring crosspiece's center, sized to accommodate a shaft one cun in diameter.

sentences.zh: 北極軸中心為孔，孔底橫穿，通兩旁，中出一線，曲其本，出橫孔兩旁結之。

translations.literal: The north polar shaft's center has a hole; the hole's bottom is pierced horizontally, passing through both sides; from the center a thread emerges, bending at the base, emerging from both sides of the horizontal hole and knotted.
translations.idiomatic: The north polar shaft has a hole at its center, pierced horizontally at the bottom through both sides; a thread emerges from the center, bends at the base, passes through both sides of the horizontal hole, and is knotted.

sentences.zh: 孔中線留三分，亦結之，上下各穿一線，貫界衡兩端，中心為孔，下洞衡底，順衡中心為渠以受線，直入內界長竅中。

translations.literal: The thread in the hole leaves three fen and is also knotted; above and below each a thread is passed through, piercing both ends of the boundary rule; the center has a hole, the bottom opening through the rule's base; along the rule's center a channel is made to receive the thread, entering straight into the inner boundary's long aperture.
translations.idiomatic: Three fen of thread remain in the hole and are knotted; threads above and below pass through holes at both ends of the boundary rule, opening through the rule's base along a channel cut along its center to receive the thread, which enters straight into the inner boundary's long aperture.

sentences.zh: 至衡中腰，復為孔，自衡底上出結之。

translations.literal: Reaching the rule's waist, again an aperture is made; from the rule's base upward it emerges and is knotted.
translations.idiomatic: At the rule's waist another aperture is made, and the thread emerges through the rule's base and is knotted.

sentences.zh: 定極環，廣半寸，厚倍之，皆勢穹窿，中徑六度，度約一寸許。

translations.literal: The fixed-pole ring: half a cun wide, thickness double that, all in arched vault form; inner diameter six degrees, each degree about one cun or so.
translations.idiomatic: The fixed-pole ring is half a cun wide and twice that thick, arched in form, with an inner diameter of six degrees, each degree about one cun.

sentences.zh: 極星去不動處三度，僅容轉周。

translations.literal: The pole star is three degrees from the unmoving place, barely allowing a full rotation.
translations.idiomatic: The pole star lies three degrees from the unmoving point, allowing barely a full rotation.

sentences.zh: 中為斜十字距，廣厚如環，連於上規。

translations.literal: In the center is a diagonal cross crosspiece, width and thickness like the ring, connected to the upper ring.
translations.idiomatic: At its center a diagonal cross crosspiece, matching the ring in width and thickness, connects to the upper ring.

translations.literal: At the ring crosspiece's center is a hole, five li in diameter.
translations.idiomatic: At the ring crosspiece's center is a hole five li in diameter.

sentences.zh: 下至北極軸心六寸五分，又置銅板，連於南極雲架之十字，方二寸，厚五分。

translations.literal: Down to the north polar shaft's center is six cun five fen; further a copper plate is placed, connected to the south polar cloud-frame's cross, square two cun, five fen thick.
translations.idiomatic: Six cun five fen below is the north polar shaft's center; a copper plate is also set, connected to the south polar cloud-frame's cross, two cun square and five fen thick.

sentences.zh: 北面剡其中心，存一厘以為厚，中為圜孔，徑一分，孔心下至南極軸心亦六寸五分。

translations.literal: On the north face its center is cut away, leaving one li as thickness; in the center is a round hole, one fen in diameter; from the hole's center down to the south polar shaft's center is likewise six cun five fen.
translations.idiomatic: Its north face is hollowed at the center, leaving one li of thickness; at the center is a round hole one fen in diameter, and from the hole's center to the south polar shaft's center is likewise six cun five fen.

sentences.zh: 又為環二：其一陰緯環，面刻方位，取趺面縱橫光北十字為中心，臥置之。

translations.literal: Further, two rings are made: one the yin-latitude ring, its face engraved with directions; taking the pedestal surface's longitudinal and transverse sight-lines' northern cross as center, it is laid horizontally.
translations.idiomatic: Two rings are also made: the first is the yin-latitude ring, its face engraved with the directions, laid horizontally with the northern cross of the pedestal's longitudinal and transverse sight-lines as its center.

sentences.zh: 其一曰立運環，面刻度分，施於北極雲架柱下，當臥環中心，上屬架之橫光，下抵趺光之十字，上下各施樞軸，令可旋轉。

translations.literal: One is called the standing-motion ring, its face marked with degrees and minutes, applied below the north polar cloud-frame pillars, facing the horizontal ring's center; above attached to the frame's transverse sight-line, below reaching the pedestal sight-lines' cross—above and below each fitted with pivot shafts, enabling rotation.
translations.idiomatic: The second is called the standing-motion ring, its face graduated in degrees and minutes, set below the north polar cloud-frame pillars at the horizontal ring's center, attached above to the frame's transverse sight-line and reaching below to the pedestal sight-lines' cross, with pivot shafts above and below allowing rotation.

sentences.zh: 中為直距，當心為竅，以施窺衡，令可俯仰，用窺日月星辰出地度分。

translations.literal: In the center is a straight crosspiece; at the center an aperture, to apply the sighting rule, enabling elevation and depression, used to sight the sun, moon, stars, and constellations' degrees of emergence above the earth.
translations.idiomatic: A straight crosspiece at the center has an aperture for the sighting rule, which can be raised and lowered to sight the degrees at which the sun, moon, stars, and constellations emerge above the horizon.

sentences.zh: 右四遊環，東西運轉，南北低昂，凡七政、列舍、中外官去極度分皆測之。

translations.literal: The four-tour ring described above rotates east-west and rises and falls north-south—all seven regulators, lodges, and inner and outer asterisms' degrees from the pole are measured by it.
translations.idiomatic: By the four-tour ring described above, rotating east-west and rising and falling north-south, the degrees from the pole of the seven regulators, lodges, and inner and outer asterisms are all measured.

sentences.zh: 赤道環旋轉，與列舍距星相當，即轉界衡使兩線相對，凡日月五星、中外官入宿度分皆測之。

translations.literal: The equatorial ring rotates; when aligned with a lodge's determinant star, the boundary rule is turned so the two threads face each other—all sun, moon, five stars, and inner and outer asterisms' degrees of entry into lodges are measured.
translations.idiomatic: The equatorial ring rotates; when aligned with a lodge's determinant star, the boundary rule is turned until the two threads face each other, measuring the degrees at which the sun, moon, five stars, and inner and outer asterisms enter the lodges.

sentences.zh: 百刻環，轉界衡令兩線與日相對，其下直時刻，則晝刻也，夜則以星定之。

translations.literal: The hundred-mark ring: turn the boundary rule so the two threads face the sun; directly below are the hours and marks—thus the day marks; at night stars determine them.
translations.idiomatic: With the hundred-mark ring, turn the boundary rule until the two threads face the sun; the mark directly below gives the daytime hour, while at night stars are used to determine it.

sentences.zh: 比舊儀測日月五星出沒，而無陽經陰緯雲柱之映。

translations.literal: Compared with the old instrument for measuring the sun, moon, and five stars' rising and setting, there is no obstruction from yang-meridian, yin-latitude, and cloud pillars.
translations.idiomatic: Compared with the old instrument for measuring the rising and setting of the sun, moon, and five stars, there is no obstruction from the yang-meridian, yin-latitude, and cloud pillars.

sentences.zh: 其渾象之制，圜如彈丸，徑六尺，縱橫各畫周天度分。

translations.literal: The construction of its celestial globe: round like a pellet, six chi in diameter, longitudinally and latitudinally each painted with the degrees and minutes of the full circuit of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Its celestial globe is spherical like a pellet, six chi in diameter, with the degrees and minutes of the full circuit of Heaven painted longitudinally and latitudinally.

sentences.zh: 赤道居中，去二極，各周天四之一。

translations.literal: The equator is centered; from the two poles, each a quarter of the full circuit of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The equator is centered, each pole lying a quarter of the full circuit of Heaven away.

sentences.zh: 黃道出入赤道內外，各二十四度弱。

translations.literal: The ecliptic enters and exits inside and outside the equator, each a little less than twenty-four degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic crosses inside and outside the equator by a little less than twenty-four degrees in each direction.

sentences.zh: 月行白道，出入不常，用竹篾均分天度，考驗黃道所交，隨時遷徙。

translations.literal: The moon travels the white path, its entry and exit not constant; bamboo splints evenly divide the heavenly degrees, verifying where the ecliptic intersects, migrating with the seasons.
translations.idiomatic: The moon travels the white path, its crossings variable; bamboo splints evenly divide the heavenly degrees to verify where the ecliptic intersects, shifting with the seasons.

sentences.zh: 先用簡儀測到入宿去極度數，按於其上，校驗出入黃赤二道遠近疏密，了然易辨，仍參以算數為準。

translations.literal: First use the simplified armillary to measure degrees of lodge entry and distance from the pole, apply them upon it, verify the ecliptic and equator's two paths' nearness, distance, sparseness, and density—clear and easy to distinguish—still taking calculation as the standard.
translations.idiomatic: First use the simplified armillary to measure degrees of lodge entry and distance from the pole, apply them to the globe, and verify the relative positions of the ecliptic and equator—clear and easy to distinguish—while still taking calculation as the standard.

sentences.zh: 其象置於方匱之上，南北極出入匱面各四十度太強，半見半隱，機運輪牙隱於匱中。

translations.literal: The globe is placed upon a square chest; north and south poles each enter and exit the chest's surface a little more than forty degrees, half seen half hidden; the mechanism's wheels and cogs are concealed within the chest.
translations.idiomatic: The globe rests upon a square chest, the north and south poles each projecting a little more than forty degrees above and below the chest's surface, half visible and half concealed, with the driving wheels and gears hidden within the chest.

translations.literal: ○ Upward-Looking Instrument
translations.idiomatic: ○ The Upward-Looking Instrument

sentences.zh: 仰儀之制，以銅為之，形若釜，置於磚臺。

translations.literal: The construction of the upward-looking instrument: made of copper, shaped like a cauldron, placed on a brick platform.
translations.idiomatic: The upward-looking instrument is made of copper, shaped like a cauldron, and set upon a brick platform.

sentences.zh: 內畫周天度，唇列十二辰位，蓋俯視驗天者也。

translations.literal: Inside are painted the degrees of the full circuit of Heaven; the rim arrays the twelve double-hour positions—it is for looking down to verify Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The interior is painted with the degrees of the full circuit of Heaven and the rim marked with the twelve double-hour positions—it is used to verify Heaven by looking downward.

sentences.zh: 其《銘》辭云：「不可體形，莫天大也。

translations.literal: Its inscription reads: "It cannot be embodied in form; nothing is greater than Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Its inscription reads: "Heaven cannot be given bodily form; nothing is greater than Heaven.

translations.literal: Without rival is man; looking up at the cauldron he is borne.
translations.idiomatic: Without rival is man, who looks up at the cauldron that bears him.

translations.literal: Six chi for depth, the width itself doubled.
translations.idiomatic: Six chi for its depth, its width twice that.

translations.literal: Combining depth and width doubled, it is the cauldron of dui.
translations.idiomatic: Depth and width both doubled, it is the cauldron of dui.

translations.literal: A ring is carved as a marsh, the standard by which to irrigate.
translations.idiomatic: A ring is carved as a marsh, the standard by which to irrigate.

translations.literal: Discerning squareness and setting position, it is called the zi hexagram.
translations.idiomatic: Discerning squareness and fixing position, it is called the zi hexagram.

translations.literal: The cross-rod's contracting scale at center, level and slant adjust again.
translations.idiomatic: On the cross-rod, the contracting scale marks the center; level and tilt are set once more.

translations.literal: Slanting up toward the south pole, level with the cauldron's rim.
translations.idiomatic: It rises obliquely toward the south pole, level with the cauldron's rim.

translations.literal: Large and small must go full circle, painted where they enter earth.
translations.idiomatic: Great and small paths must run full circle, painted where they sink into the earth.

translations.literal: At first full circle then dipping cut off, dipping outside the pole.
translations.idiomatic: At first the path runs full circle, then dips and breaks off, dipping beyond the pole.

translations.literal: Pole entering earth depth forty and a fraction.
translations.idiomatic: The pole's depth below the earth is forty degrees and a fraction.

translations.literal: To the north ninety-one, equator meets.
translations.idiomatic: Ninety-one degrees to the north, where the equator meets it.

translations.literal: Arrayed marks fifty, six watches paired.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty marks are arrayed, paired with the six watches of the day.

translations.literal: Cross-rod added hexagram, xun and kun within.
translations.idiomatic: The cross-rod bears hexagram marks, with xun and kun set within.

translations.literal: Using it to bear the contracting rod, north-south opposed.
translations.idiomatic: It supports the contracting rod, north and south set in opposition.

translations.literal: At the head rotating the ji board, sunlight receives a mustard seed.
translations.idiomatic: At the top the armillary board turns, admitting sunlight through a pinhole no larger than a mustard seed.

translations.literal: Upper and lower suspended straight, meeting the rim.
translations.idiomatic: Above and below hang plumb straight, meeting at the cauldron's rim.

translations.literal: Viewing the sun's penetrating light, which degree it is at.
translations.idiomatic: Watch the sun's light pass through, and see at which degree it stands.

translations.literal: Pure valley morning guest, evening seeing off twilight.
translations.idiomatic: At the narrow valley it greets the morning sun; at evening it sees off the fading light.

translations.literal: Cold and heat expanding and contracting, verifying advance and retreat.
translations.idiomatic: Cold and heat expand and contract, verifying the sun's advance and retreat.

translations.literal: Thin eclipse arising from, mirror of life and death.
translations.idiomatic: Thin eclipses arise from it, a mirror of generation and destruction.

translations.literal: To avoid blazing sun, robbing eyes harm.
translations.idiomatic: It avoids the blazing sun, sparing the eyes from harm.

translations.literal: North-south deflection, also can be reckoned in general.
translations.idiomatic: North-south deflection can also be reckoned at a glance.

translations.literal: Pole shallow fifteen, Linyi border.
translations.idiomatic: Where the pole is shallow by fifteen degrees, at the border of Linyi.

translations.literal: Ecliptic summer high, what men bear.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic rides high in summer, as men are borne upon the earth.

translations.literal: Summer long winter short, still slight difference.
translations.idiomatic: Summer days are long and winter days short, yet the difference remains slight.

translations.literal: Depth fifty odd, iron bands block.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty-odd degrees deep, iron bands seal it shut.

translations.literal: Ecliptic dipping level, winter daylight dim.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic dips level; winter daylight grows dim.

translations.literal: Summer then does not set, eternal shortness utmost.
translations.idiomatic: In summer the sun does not set; the shortest day marks the utmost limit.

translations.literal: Settling Hun Tian and Xuan Ye, dawn dome canopy.
translations.idiomatic: It settles the Hun Tian and Xuan Ye schools, the dawn dome of the canopy sky.

translations.literal: Six heavens' books, words different speech.
translations.idiomatic: Books of the six heavens speak in different tongues.

translations.literal: One instrument one measure, which good which perverse.
translations.idiomatic: One instrument, one standard—which is sound and which is perverse?

translations.literal: By pointing to inform, no need for chatter.
translations.idiomatic: It tells by pointing; there is no need for idle talk.

translations.literal: Dark aided by bright, doubters abundant.
translations.idiomatic: Darkness is aided by light, and doubters abound.

translations.literal: Wise approve it, sticklers marvel.
translations.idiomatic: The wise approve it; the obstinate find it strange.

translations.literal: Past present clever calendar experts, not hundreds of millions of generations.
translations.idiomatic: Clever calendar experts past and present cannot be numbered in the millions.

translations.literal: Not deferring then not doing, thought not reaching.
translations.idiomatic: Without yielding humility one dare not act, for thought cannot reach so far.

translations.literal: Will spy Heaven's countenance, creation's love.
translations.idiomatic: It will spy Heaven's countenance, beloved of creation.

translations.literal: If there is eminent brilliance, illumines sage generation.
translations.idiomatic: Should there be eminent brilliance, it illumines a sage generation.

translations.literal: Mount Tai ground on whetstone, river like belt.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Tai may be ground on a whetstone, the river become a belt.

translations.literal: Gold not worn down, long-lasting reliance.
translations.idiomatic: Gold is not worn away; long endurance depends on it.

translations.literal: Spirits forbid reproach, do not mar inscription."
translations.idiomatic: Spirits forbid reproach—do not mar this inscription."

translations.literal: ○ Daming Hall Lamp Clepsydra
translations.idiomatic: ○ The Daming Hall Lamp Clepsydra

sentences.zh: 燈漏之制，高丈有七尺，架以金為之。

translations.literal: The construction of the lamp clepsydra: height one zhang plus seven chi, the frame made of gold.
translations.idiomatic: The lamp clepsydra stands one zhang and seven chi high, its frame wrought in gold.

sentences.zh: 其曲梁之上，中設雲珠，左日右月。

translations.literal: Upon its curved beam, at center is set a cloud pearl, sun at left and moon at right.
translations.idiomatic: On the curved beam a cloud pearl is set at the center, with the sun on the left and the moon on the right.

translations.literal: Below the cloud pearl, again a pearl is suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Beneath the cloud pearl another pearl is suspended.

sentences.zh: 梁之兩端，飾以龍首，張吻轉目，可以審平水之緩急。

translations.literal: Both ends of the beam are adorned with dragon heads, mouths open and eyes turning, by which one may judge the level water's slowness or haste.
translations.idiomatic: Both ends of the beam are adorned with dragon heads, mouths agape and eyes turning, by which one may judge whether the leveling water runs slow or fast.

sentences.zh: 中梁之上，有戲珠龍二，隨珠俯仰，又可察準水之均調。

translations.literal: Upon the central beam are two pearl-playing dragons, following the pearl in bowing and raising, by which one may also observe the standard water's even regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On the central beam stand two dragons playing with a pearl, bobbing as the pearl rises and falls, by which one may also observe whether the regulating water is evenly adjusted.

translations.literal: All these are not set up in vain.
translations.idiomatic: None of these features are merely ornamental.

sentences.zh: 燈球雜以金寶為之，內分四層，上環布四神，旋當日月參辰之所在，左轉日一周。

translations.literal: The lamp sphere is made mixed with gold and jewels, divided within into four layers; the upper ring arrays the four spirits, rotating to the positions of sun, moon, and constellations, turning left one circuit of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: The lamp sphere is wrought of gold and precious stones, divided within into four layers. The upper ring bears the four guardian spirits, turning to the positions of the sun, moon, and stars; it rotates leftward through one solar circuit.

sentences.zh: 次為龍虎鳥龜之象，各居其方，依刻跳躍，鐃鳴以應於內。

translations.literal: Next are images of dragon, tiger, bird, and tortoise, each occupying its direction, leaping according to the marks, cymbals sounding in response within.
translations.idiomatic: Below them are figures of the dragon, tiger, bird, and tortoise, each in its quarter, leaping at each mark while cymbals sound in response within.

sentences.zh: 又次周分百刻，上列十二神，各執時牌，至其時，四門通報。

translations.literal: Again below, the full circuit divided into one hundred marks; above are arrayed twelve spirits, each holding a time tablet; when the hour comes, all four gates announce it.
translations.idiomatic: Below that the day is divided into one hundred marks, with twelve spirits arrayed above, each holding a time tablet; when the hour arrives, all four gates announce it.

sentences.zh: 又一人當門內，常以手指其刻數。

translations.literal: Again one man stands inside the gate, always pointing with his finger to the mark number.
translations.idiomatic: Inside the gate a figure stands, always pointing out the number of the mark.

sentences.zh: 下四隅，鐘鼓鉦鐃各一人，一刻鳴鐘，二刻鼓，三鉦，四鐃，初正皆如是。

translations.literal: At the four lower corners, bell, drum, gong, and cymbal each have one man; at one mark the bell sounds, at two the drum, at three the gong, at four the cymbal—at the start of each watch it is all thus.
translations.idiomatic: At the four lower corners stand figures for bell, drum, gong, and cymbal; at the first mark the bell sounds, at the second the drum, at the third the gong, at the fourth the cymbal—and so through each watch of the day.

sentences.zh: 其機發隱於櫃中，以水激之。

translations.literal: Its mechanism and triggers are concealed within a cabinet, driven by water.
translations.idiomatic: Its mechanism and triggers are concealed in a cabinet and driven by water.

translations.literal: ○ Levelling Square Plate
translations.idiomatic: ○ The Levelling Square Plate

translations.literal: The levelling square plate is four chi square, one cun thick.
translations.idiomatic: The levelling square plate is four chi square and one cun thick.

translations.literal: All around, five fen inward from the edge is made a water channel.
translations.idiomatic: A water channel five fen wide is cut all around, inset from the edge.

sentences.zh: 先定中心，畫為十字，外抵水渠。

translations.literal: First fix the center, draw it as a cross, outward reaching the water channel.
translations.idiomatic: First fix the center and draw a cross reaching outward to the water channel.

sentences.zh: 去心一寸，畫為圓規，自外寸規之，凡十九規。

translations.literal: One cun from the center, draw as circular compass; from outside by cun compass it, altogether nineteen compasses.
translations.idiomatic: One cun from the center draw a circle; then draw circles at each cun outward, nineteen circles in all.

sentences.zh: 外規內三分，畫為重規，遍布周天度。

translations.literal: Within the outer compass three fen, draw as double compass, spread throughout with the degrees of the full circuit of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Three fen inside the outer circle draw a second circle, marked throughout with the degrees of the full circuit of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 中為圓，徑二寸，高亦如之。

translations.literal: At center is a circle, diameter two cun, height likewise.
translations.idiomatic: At the center is a circular socket two cun in diameter and equally deep.

sentences.zh: 中心洞底植臬，高一尺五寸，南至則減五寸，北至則倍之。

translations.literal: At the center's hollow bottom plant the gnomon post, height one chi five cun; going southward reduce five cun, going northward double it.
translations.idiomatic: In the socket at the center plant the gnomon post, one chi five cun high; traveling southward reduce it by five cun, traveling northward double it.

sentences.zh: 凡欲正四方，置案平地，註水於渠，氐平，乃植臬於中。

translations.literal: Whenever one wishes to square the four directions, set the plate on level ground, pour water into the channel until the base is level, then plant the gnomon post at center.
translations.idiomatic: To square the four directions, set the plate on level ground, fill the channel until the water is level, then plant the gnomon post at the center.

sentences.zh: 自臬景西入外規，即識以墨影，少移輒識之，每規皆然，至東出外規而止。

translations.literal: From the gnomon shadow entering the outer compass from the west, immediately mark it with ink shadow; moving slightly mark again, each compass all thus, until east exiting the outer compass then stop.
translations.idiomatic: From when the gnomon's shadow enters the outer circle from the west, mark each position in ink; mark again at every slight shift, circle by circle, until the shadow exits the outer circle on the east.

sentences.zh: 凡出入一規之交，皆度以線，屈其半以為中，即所識與臬相當，且其景最短，則南北正矣。

translations.literal: Wherever entering and exiting one compass's crossing, all measure with a cord, bend its half as center; then the marks align with the gnomon, and its shadow shortest—then north-south is correct.
translations.idiomatic: For each pair of marks where the shadow enters and leaves a circle, stretch a cord and fold it in half to find the midpoint; where the mark aligns with the gnomon and the shadow is shortest, north and south are true.

sentences.zh: 復遍閱每規之識，以審定南北。

translations.literal: Again review all each compass's marks, to verify and fix north-south.
translations.idiomatic: Review the marks on every circle again to confirm north and south.

sentences.zh: 南北既正，則東西從而正。

translations.literal: North-south already correct, then east-west follows and is correct.
translations.idiomatic: Once north and south are true, east and west follow of themselves.

sentences.zh: 然二至前後，日軌東西行，南北差少，即外規出入之景以為東西，允得其正。

translations.literal: Yet before and after the two solstices, the sun's path travels east-west, north-south difference slight; then use the outer compass's entering and exiting shadows for east-west, truly obtaining correctness.
translations.idiomatic: Near the two solstices the sun's path runs chiefly east-west with little north-south deviation, so the marks where the shadow enters and leaves the outer circle may be taken for east and west with good accuracy.

sentences.zh: 當二分前後，日軌東西行，南北差多，朝夕有不同者，外規出入之景或未可憑，必取近內規景為定，仍校以累日則愈真。

translations.literal: At the two equinoxes before and after, the sun's path travels east-west, north-south difference much, morning and evening having differences; the outer compass's entering and exiting shadows perhaps cannot be relied on—must take the near inner compass shadow as standard, still comparing over successive days then more true.
translations.idiomatic: Near the two equinoxes the sun's path runs east-west with greater north-south deviation, and morning and evening differ; the outer-circle marks may not be reliable—one must take marks on the inner circles as the standard, checking over several days for greater accuracy.

sentences.zh: 又測用之法，先測定所在北極出地度，即自案地平以上度，如其數下對南極入地度，以墨斜經中心界之，又橫截中心斜界為十字，即天腹赤道斜勢也。

translations.literal: Again the method for measurement use: first measure and fix the local north pole's degrees emerging from earth; then from the plate's level upward by degrees, according to its number downward opposing the south pole's degrees entering earth, with ink slanting through the center to bound it; again horizontally cutting the center's slanting bound as a cross—this is the celestial belly equator's slanting trend.
translations.idiomatic: For use in observation, first measure the local altitude of the north celestial pole above the horizon; from the plate's level mark that many degrees upward and the corresponding degrees of the south pole below, draw an ink line slanting through the center, then cross it horizontally at the center—this gives the oblique line of the celestial equator.

translations.literal: Then with the plate's side upright, suspend a cord to obtain correctness.
translations.idiomatic: Then set the plate on edge and hang a plumb line to establish the true vertical.

translations.literal: Whenever setting up instruments and armillary models, all take this as standard.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever astronomical instruments are set up, this serves as the standard.

translations.literal: ○ Gnomon Table
translations.idiomatic: ○ The Gnomon Table

sentences.zh: 圭表以石為之，長一百二十八尺，廣四尺五寸，厚一尺四寸，座高二尺六寸。

translations.literal: The gnomon table is made of stone, length one hundred twenty-eight chi, width four chi five cun, thickness one chi four cun, pedestal height two chi six cun.
translations.idiomatic: The gnomon table is made of stone, one hundred twenty-eight chi long, four chi five cun wide, one chi four cun thick, on a pedestal two chi six cun high.

sentences.zh: 南北兩端為池，圓徑一尺五寸，深二寸，自表北一尺，與表梁中心上下相直。

translations.literal: North and south ends are pools, circular diameter one chi five cun, depth two cun; from the table's north one chi, with the table beam's center aligned above and below.
translations.idiomatic: At the north and south ends are circular pools one chi five cun across and two cun deep; one chi north of the table, their centers align vertically with the crossbeam.

sentences.zh: 外一百二十尺，中心廣四寸，兩旁各一寸，畫為尺寸分，以達北端。

translations.literal: Outward one hundred twenty chi, center width four cun, each side one cun, painted as cun, fen, and subdivisions, reaching to the north end.
translations.idiomatic: For one hundred twenty chi outward from the center, a strip four cun wide at the center and one cun on each side is marked in cun, fen, and finer divisions, running to the north end.

sentences.zh: 兩旁相去一寸為水渠，深廣各一寸，與南北兩池相灌通以取平。

translations.literal: Both sides one cun apart as water channel, depth and width each one cun, with north and south pools mutually irrigating and connecting to obtain level.
translations.idiomatic: A water channel one cun wide and deep runs on either side, connecting the north and south pools to establish a level surface.

sentences.zh: 表長五十尺，廣二尺四寸，厚減廣之半，植於圭之南端圭石座中，入地及座中一丈四尺，上高三十六尺。

translations.literal: The table is fifty chi long, width two chi four cun, thickness reduced by half the width, planted in the gnomon's south end gnomon-stone socket, entering earth and socket one zhang four chi, above height thirty-six chi.
translations.idiomatic: The gnomon is fifty chi long, two chi four cun wide, half as thick as it is wide, set in the stone socket at the south end of the table; one zhang four chi is buried in the ground and pedestal, leaving thirty-six chi above.

sentences.zh: 其端兩旁為二龍，半身附表上擎橫梁，自梁心至表顛四尺，下屬圭面，共為四十尺。

translations.literal: Its top on both sides are two dragons, half bodies attached to the table supporting a crossbeam; from beam center to table top four chi, below joining the gnomon face, altogether forty chi.
translations.idiomatic: At its top two dragons, half-emerging from the shaft, support a crossbeam; from the beam's center to the gnomon's tip is four chi, and down to the table face the whole height is forty chi.

sentences.zh: 梁長六尺，徑三寸，上為水渠以取平。

translations.literal: Beam length six chi, diameter three cun, above is a water channel to obtain level.
translations.idiomatic: The beam is six chi long and three cun in diameter, with a water channel along its top for leveling.

sentences.zh: 兩端及中腰各為橫竅，徑二分，橫貫以鐵，長五寸，系線合於中，懸錘取正，且防傾墊。

translations.literal: Both ends and central waist each have horizontal openings, diameter two fen, horizontally pierced with iron five cun long, cord tied meeting at center, suspended weight to obtain correctness, and guard against tilting.
translations.idiomatic: Horizontal holes two fen wide pierce both ends and the center of the beam; iron rods five cun long pass through them, cords meet at the center, and a plumb bob hangs to true the beam and guard against tilting.

sentences.zh: 按表短則分寸短促，尺寸之下所謂分秒太半少之數，未易分別；

translations.literal: Considering: if the table is short then cun and fen are short and cramped; below cun and fen the so-called fen, miao, tai, ban, shao numbers are not easy to distinguish;
translations.idiomatic: When the gnomon is short, the cun and fen on the scale are cramped, and the fractional subdivisions below—fen, miao, tai, ban, and shao—are hard to distinguish;

sentences.zh: 表長則分寸稍長，所不便者景虛而淡，難得實影。

translations.literal: if the table is long then cun and fen are somewhat long; what is inconvenient is the shadow faint and pale, hard to obtain a solid image.
translations.idiomatic: when it is long the cun and fen are easier to read, but the shadow grows faint and diffuse, making a sharp image hard to obtain.

sentences.zh: 前人欲就虛景之中考求真實，或設望筒，或置小表，或以木為規，皆取端日光，下徹表面。

translations.literal: Former men wishing from within the faint image to investigate and seek the true, either set up a sighting tube, or placed a small table, or used wood as compass—all taking the top's sunlight, penetrating down to the surface.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier observers, seeking the true reading within a diffuse shadow, used a sighting tube, a small gnomon, or a wooden frame—all to catch the sunlight at the tip and direct it down to the measuring surface.

sentences.zh: 今以銅為表，高三十六尺，端挾以二龍，舉一橫梁，下至圭面共四十尺，是為八尺之表五。

translations.literal: Now using copper for the table, height thirty-six chi, top clasped with two dragons, raising one crossbeam, from below to gnomon face altogether forty chi—this is an eight-chi table times five.
translations.idiomatic: Now the gnomon is made of bronze, thirty-six chi high, with two dragons at the top supporting a crossbeam; from the beam down to the table face the total height is forty chi—equivalent to five times the standard eight-chi gnomon.

sentences.zh: 圭表刻為尺寸，舊一寸，今申而為五，厘毫差易分別。

translations.literal: The gnomon table is carved as cun and fen; formerly one cun, now expanded to five; li and hao differences easy to distinguish.
translations.idiomatic: The table is marked in cun and fen; where the old scale showed one cun, the new scale expands it to five, so li and hao divisions are easily distinguished.

translations.literal: ○ Shadow Reticle
translations.idiomatic: ○ The Shadow Reticle

sentences.zh: 景符之制，以銅葉，博二寸，長加博之二，中穿一竅，若針芥然。

translations.literal: The construction of the shadow reticle: using a copper leaf, width two cun, length adding twice the width, center pierced with one opening like a needle's mustard seed.
translations.idiomatic: The shadow reticle is a copper plate two cun wide and twice as long, pierced at the center with a hole no larger than a needle's eye.

sentences.zh: 以方跂為趺，一端設為機軸，令可開闔，榰其一端，使其勢斜倚，北高南下，往來遷就於虛梁之中。

translations.literal: Using a square base as pedestal, one end set as mechanism pivot, allowing opening and closing; propping one end, making its posture lean slanting, north high south low, moving back and forth to fit within the hollow beam.
translations.idiomatic: It rests on a square base with a pivot at one end so it can open and close; one end is propped so the plate tilts, higher in the north and lower in the south, and can be shifted back and forth beneath the hollow crossbeam.

sentences.zh: 竅達日光，僅如米許，隱然見橫梁於其中。

translations.literal: The opening reaches sunlight, barely like a grain of rice, dimly seeing the crossbeam within it.
translations.idiomatic: Sunlight passes through the hole, barely the size of a grain of rice, and the crossbeam is faintly visible within.

sentences.zh: 舊法一表端測晷，所得者日體上邊之景。

translations.literal: The old method used one table's top to measure the gnomon shadow; what was obtained was the sun's body's upper edge's shadow.
translations.idiomatic: By the old method one measured the shadow from the gnomon's tip, obtaining only the image of the sun's upper limb.

sentences.zh: 今以橫梁取之，實得中景，不容有毫末之差。

translations.literal: Now using the crossbeam to obtain it, truly getting the central shadow, not allowing a hair's difference.
translations.idiomatic: Now the crossbeam is used instead, yielding the true central shadow, without the slightest error.

sentences.zh: 至元十六年己卯夏至晷景，四月十九日乙未景一丈二尺三寸六分九厘五毫。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan sixteen jimao summer solstice gnomon shadow: fourth month nineteenth day yimo shadow one zhang two chi three cun six fen nine li five hao.
translations.idiomatic: Summer solstice shadow in Zhiyuan 16 (1289), year jimao: on the 19th day of the 4th month (day yimo) the shadow was 1 zhang 2 chi 3 cun 6 fen 9 li 5 hao.

sentences.zh: 至元十六年己卯冬至晷景，十月二十四日戊戌景七丈六尺七寸四分。

translations.literal: Zhiyuan sixteen jimao winter solstice gnomon shadow: tenth month twenty-fourth day wuxu shadow seven zhang six chi seven cun four fen.
translations.idiomatic: Winter solstice shadow in Zhiyuan 16 (1289), year jimao: on the 24th day of the 10th month (day wuxu) the shadow was 7 zhang 6 chi 7 cun 4 fen.

translations.literal: ○ Sighting Frame
translations.idiomatic: ○ The Sighting Frame

sentences.zh: 窺幾之制，長六尺，廣二尺，高倍之。

translations.literal: The construction of the sighting frame: length six chi, width two chi, height doubled.
translations.idiomatic: The sighting frame is six chi long, two chi wide, and twice as high.

sentences.zh: 下為趺，廣三寸，厚二寸，上跂廣四寸，厚如趺。

translations.literal: Below is the pedestal, width three cun, thickness two cun; upper base width four cun, thickness like the pedestal.
translations.idiomatic: Below is a base three cun wide and two cun thick; the upper frame is four cun wide and equally thick.

sentences.zh: 以板為面，厚及寸，四隅為足，撐以斜木，務取正方。

translations.literal: Using a board as face, thickness reaching one cun, four corners as feet, braced with slanting wood, striving to obtain true square.
translations.idiomatic: The face is a board one cun thick, with feet at the four corners braced by slanting timbers, built as a true square.

sentences.zh: 面中開明竅，長四尺，廣二寸。

translations.literal: The face's center opens a bright opening, length four chi, width two cun.
translations.idiomatic: A clear aperture four chi long and two cun wide is cut in the center of the face.

sentences.zh: 近竅兩旁一寸分畫為尺，內三寸刻為細分，下應圭面。

translations.literal: Near the opening both sides one cun apart are painted as chi; within three cun carved as fine divisions, below corresponding to the gnomon face.
translations.idiomatic: One cun on either side of the aperture is marked in chi, with finer divisions carved within three cun, aligning with the gnomon table below.

sentences.zh: 幾面上至梁心二十六尺，取以為準。

translations.literal: From the frame's face up to the beam center twenty-six chi, take this as standard.
translations.idiomatic: From the frame's face to the center of the crossbeam is twenty-six chi, taken as the standard height.

sentences.zh: 窺限各各長二尺四寸，廣二寸，脊厚五分，兩刃斜閷，取其於幾面相符，著限兩端，厚廣各存二寸，銜入幾跂。

translations.literal: Sighting limits each length two chi four cun, width two cun, ridge thickness five fen, both blades slanting and notched, taking them to match the frame's face, attaching at the limits' both ends, thickness and width each retaining two cun, fitting into the frame base.
translations.idiomatic: The sighting vanes are each two chi four cun long and two cun wide, five fen thick at the ridge, with slanting notched edges fitted flush to the frame; two cun is left at each end to seat them in the frame base.

sentences.zh: 俟星月正中，從幾下仰望，視表梁南北以為識，折取分寸中數，用為直景。

translations.literal: Awaiting stars and moon at center, from below the frame look upward, viewing the table beam's north-south as mark, folding to take cun and fen's middle number, using as straight shadow.
translations.idiomatic: When a star or the moon is on the meridian, sight upward through the frame, using the crossbeam's north-south line as reference; halve the reading in cun and fen to obtain the true shadow length.

sentences.zh: 又於遠方同日窺測取景數，以推星月高下也。

translations.literal: Again at distant places on the same day peering and measuring to obtain shadow numbers, to deduce stars and moon's height and depth.
translations.idiomatic: Observations may also be taken the same day from distant stations to compare shadow lengths and deduce the altitude of stars and the moon.

sentences.zh: ○西域儀象世祖至元四年，紥馬魯丁造西域儀象：

translations.literal: ○ Western Regions Armillary Sphere: Shizu, Zhiyuan year 4, Jamal al-Din made the Western Regions armillary sphere:
translations.idiomatic: ○ Western Regions Armillary Sphere. In year 4 of Zhiyuan (1267), under Emperor Shizu, Jamal al-Din constructed the Western Regions armillary sphere:

sentences.zh: 咱禿哈剌吉，漢言混天儀也。

translations.literal: Zantu halaji—in Han speech, the armillary sphere.
translations.idiomatic: The zantu halaji: in Chinese, the armillary sphere.

sentences.zh: 其制以銅為之，平設單環，刻周天度，畫十二辰位，以準地面。

translations.literal: Its making uses copper for it; level-set a single ring, incise the degrees of the full heaven, draw the twelve chen positions, to align with the ground surface.
translations.idiomatic: It is made of copper, with a single ring set level, graduated in degrees around the full circuit of heaven and marked with the twelve terrestrial branches to align with the horizon.

sentences.zh: 側立雙環而結於平環之子午，半入地下，以分天度。

translations.literal: Side-standing double rings join at the level ring's zi-wu, half entering below earth, to divide heaven's degrees.
translations.idiomatic: A pair of rings stands vertically, joined to the level ring at the north-south axis, half sunk below the ground, to mark off the degrees of the sky.

sentences.zh: 內第二雙環，亦刻周天度，而參差相交，以結於側雙環，去地平三十六度以為南北極，可以旋轉，以象天運為日行之道。

translations.literal: Inside, a second double ring also incises full-heaven degrees, yet staggered intersecting, joining the side double rings, departing the ground level thirty-six degrees to make north-south poles, can rotate, to image heaven's motion as the sun's daily path.
translations.idiomatic: Inside, a second pair of rings, likewise graduated around the full circuit of heaven, is set at an oblique angle and joined to the vertical pair, with the poles placed thirty-six degrees above the horizon so that it can rotate and represent the motion of heaven as the path of the sun's daily course.

sentences.zh: 內第三、第四環，皆結於第二環，又去南北極二十四度，亦可以運轉。

translations.literal: Inside, third and fourth rings all join on the second ring, again departing north-south poles twenty-four degrees, also can revolve.
translations.idiomatic: The third and fourth rings within are both attached to the second ring, set a further twenty-four degrees from the poles, and can also be turned.

sentences.zh: 凡可運三環，各對綴銅方釘，皆有竅以代衡簫之仰窺焉。

translations.literal: All three rings that can move, each facing are fastened copper square nails, all have holes to substitute for the balance tube's upward peering.
translations.idiomatic: Each of the three movable rings has a copper square peg fixed opposite it, every one pierced with an aperture to serve in place of the sighting tube for observations aloft.

sentences.zh: 咱禿朔八臺，漢言測驗周天星曜之器也。

translations.literal: Zantu shuoba tai—in Han speech, the instrument for measuring and testing the full heaven's stars and luminaries.
translations.idiomatic: The zantu shuoba tai: in Chinese, the instrument for observing and verifying the stars throughout the circuit of heaven.

sentences.zh: 外周圓墻，而東面啟門，中有小臺，立銅表高七尺五寸，上設機軸，懸銅尺，長五尺五寸，復加窺測之簫二，其長如之，下置橫尺，刻度數其上，以準掛尺。

translations.literal: Outside, a surrounding circular wall, yet the east face opens a gate; within is a small terrace, standing a copper gnomon seven chi five cun high, above setting a mechanism axle, suspending a copper rule long five chi five cun; again adding two peering-and-measuring tubes, their length like it; below placing a horizontal rule, incising degree numbers upon it, to align with the suspended rule.
translations.idiomatic: It has a circular outer wall with a door opening to the east; inside stands a small platform bearing a copper gnomon seven chi five cun tall, fitted above with a pivot from which hangs a copper rod five chi five cun long, with two sighting tubes of the same length added for observation; below is a horizontal scale graduated in degrees to align with the hanging rod.

sentences.zh: 下本開圖之遠近，可以左右轉而周窺，可以高低舉而遍測。

translations.literal: Below, the base opens diagrams of distance and nearness; can turn left and right to peer all around, can raise and lower to measure everywhere.
translations.idiomatic: The base is cut with graduated arcs for near and far sighting; it can be swung left and right for a full sweep of the sky and raised or lowered for observations at every altitude.

sentences.zh: 魯哈麻亦渺凹只，漢言春秋分晷影堂。

translations.literal: Ruhama yi miao'ao zhi—in Han speech, the hall of gnomon shadows for spring and autumn equinoxes.
translations.idiomatic: The ruhama yi miao'ao zhi: in Chinese, the equinox gnomon-shadow hall.

sentences.zh: 為屋二間，脊開東西橫罅，以斜通日晷。

translations.literal: Made as a house of two bays, the ridge opening an east-west horizontal slit, to slant-connect the sundial.
translations.idiomatic: It is built as a two-bay hall with a horizontal slit along the ridge running east to west, through which the sun's rays strike the gnomon obliquely.

sentences.zh: 中有臺，隨晷影南高北下，上仰置銅半環，刻天度一百八十，以準地上之半天，斜倚銳者銅尺，長六尺，闊一寸六分，上結半環之中，下加半環之上，可以往來窺運，側望漏屋晷影，驗度數，以定春秋二分。

translations.literal: Within is a terrace, following the gnomon shadow south high north low; above, face-upward placing a copper half-ring, incising heaven's degrees one hundred eighty, to align with half heaven above ground; slant-leaning a sharp copper rule, long six chi, wide one cun six fen, above joining the half-ring's center, below adding upon the half-ring's top, can go and come peering and revolving, sidelong viewing the leaking-house gnomon shadow, verifying degree numbers, to fix spring and autumn's two equinoxes.
translations.idiomatic: Inside is a platform sloping southward and downward to the north with the noon shadow; set upon it face upward is a copper semicircle graduated in one hundred eighty degrees of the sky to match the visible half of the heavens; a sharp-edged copper rod six chi long and one cun six fen wide leans against it, joined at the top to the center of the semicircle and resting below upon its rim, so that it can be moved back and forth for sighting; by viewing the gnomon shadow cast through the roof slit from the side and checking the degrees, the spring and autumn equinoxes are determined.

sentences.zh: 魯哈麻亦木思塔余，漢言冬夏至晷影堂也。

translations.literal: Ruhama yi musita yu—in Han speech, the hall of gnomon shadows for winter and summer solstices.
translations.idiomatic: The ruhama yi musita yu: in Chinese, the solstice gnomon-shadow hall.

sentences.zh: 為屋五間，屋下為坎，深二丈二尺，脊開南北一罅，以直通日晷。

translations.literal: Made as a house of five bays; below the house is a pit, deep two zhang two chi; the ridge opens one north-south slit, to pass straight through to the sundial.
translations.idiomatic: It is built as a five-bay hall with a pit beneath, two zhang two chi deep; a north-south slit in the ridge admits the sun's rays straight down to the gnomon.

sentences.zh: 隨罅立壁，附壁懸銅尺，長一丈六寸。

translations.literal: Following the slit, standing a wall; attached to the wall, suspending a copper rule, long one zhang six cun.
translations.idiomatic: A wall stands along the slit, and a copper rod one zhang six cun long is hung against it.

sentences.zh: 壁仰畫天度半規，其尺亦可往來規運，直望漏屋晷影，以定冬夏二至。

translations.literal: The wall, face-upward, draws heaven's degrees as a half-circle; its rule also can go and come in compass motion, straight viewing the leaking-house gnomon shadow, to fix winter and summer's two solstices.
translations.idiomatic: Painted facing upward on the wall is a semicircle of celestial degrees; the rod too can be shifted along this arc; by sighting directly upon the gnomon shadow cast through the roof, the winter and summer solstices are fixed.

sentences.zh: 苦來亦撒麻，漢言渾天圖也。

translations.literal: Kulai yi sama—in Han speech, the chart of the armillary heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The kulai yi sama: in Chinese, the celestial globe.

sentences.zh: 其制以銅為丸，斜刻日道交環度數於其腹，刻二十八宿形於其上。

translations.literal: Its making uses copper as a sphere; slant-incising the sun's path and intersecting rings' degree numbers on its belly, incising the twenty-eight lodges' forms upon its top.
translations.idiomatic: It is a copper sphere with the degrees of the sun's path and its intersecting rings cut obliquely upon its surface, and the figures of the twenty-eight lunar lodges engraved upon it.

sentences.zh: 外平置銅單環，刻周天度數，列於十二辰位以準地。

translations.literal: Outside, level-placing a copper single ring, incising full-heaven degree numbers, arrayed at the twelve chen positions to align with earth.
translations.idiomatic: Around it is set level a single copper ring graduated in degrees around the full circuit of heaven and marked with the twelve terrestrial branches to align with the ground.

sentences.zh: 而側立單環二，一結於平環之子午，以銅丁象南北極，一結於平環之卯酉，皆刻天度。

translations.literal: Yet side-standing two single rings: one joins at the level ring's zi-wu, using copper pegs to image north-south poles; one joins at the level ring's mao-you, all incising heaven's degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Two single rings stand vertically: one joined to the level ring at the north-south axis, with copper pegs marking the poles; one joined at the east-west axis—both graduated in celestial degrees.

sentences.zh: 即渾天儀而不可運轉窺測者也。

translations.literal: That is, the armillary sphere yet cannot revolve for peering and measurement.
translations.idiomatic: It is essentially an armillary sphere, but one that cannot be turned for observation.

sentences.zh: 苦來亦阿兒子，漢言地理志也。

translations.literal: Kulai yi a'erzi—in Han speech, the geographical treatise.
translations.idiomatic: The kulai yi a'erzi: in Chinese, the terrestrial globe.

sentences.zh: 其制以木為圓球，七分為水，其色綠，三分為土地，其色白。

translations.literal: Its making uses wood as a round sphere; seven parts are water, its color green; three parts are land and soil, its color white.
translations.idiomatic: It is a wooden sphere on which seven-tenths represent water, colored green, and three-tenths land, colored white.

sentences.zh: 畫江河湖海，脈絡貫串於其中。

translations.literal: Drawing rivers, lakes, and seas, veins and threads running through within.
translations.idiomatic: Rivers, lakes, and seas are painted upon it, their courses threaded through in continuous lines.

sentences.zh: 畫作小方井，以計幅圓之廣袤、道里之遠近。

translations.literal: Drawn as small square wells, to calculate the breadth and length of the draped sphere, roads and li's distance and nearness.
translations.idiomatic: It is marked with small square grids by which to reckon the sphere's breadth and girth and the distances between places.

sentences.zh: 兀速都兒剌不，定漢言，晝夜時刻之器。

translations.literal: Wusu du'erlabu—fixed Han speech: the instrument of day-and-night hours and moments.
translations.idiomatic: The wusu du'erlabu: in Chinese, the instrument for telling the hours of day and night.

sentences.zh: 其制以銅如圓鏡而可掛，面刻十二辰位、晝夜時刻，上加銅條綴其中，可以圓轉。

translations.literal: Its making uses copper like a round mirror and can be hung; the face incises twelve chen positions, day-and-night hours and moments; above adding a copper strip fastened within, can revolve circularly.
translations.idiomatic: It is made of copper in the form of a round mirror that can be hung up, its face marked with the twelve terrestrial branches and the hours of day and night; a copper bar is pivoted across its center so that it can rotate.

sentences.zh: 銅條兩端，各屈其首為二竅以對望，晝則視日影，夜則窺星辰，以定時刻，以測休咎。

translations.literal: The copper strip's two ends, each bending its head into two holes to face and view each other; by day then viewing the sun's shadow, by night then peering at stars and constellations, to fix hours and moments, to measure fortune and misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: Each end of the copper bar is bent into a pair of sighting holes facing one another; by day the sun's shadow is read, by night the stars are sighted, to determine the hour and to discern auspice and ill omen.

sentences.zh: 背嵌鏡片，三面刻其圖凡七，以辨東西南北日影長短之不同、星辰向背之有異，故各異其圖，以畫天地之變焉。

translations.literal: The back inlays mirror pieces; three faces incise its diagrams totaling seven, to distinguish east-west-south-north sun-shadow length and shortness's differences, stars and constellations facing and backing's having variation; therefore each differs its diagram, to depict heaven-and-earth's transformations.
translations.idiomatic: Mirror plates are set into the back, with seven diagrams engraved on three faces, to show how the length of the noon shadow differs in the four directions and how the stars vary in their aspect toward the observer; hence a separate diagram for each, depicting the transformations of heaven and earth.

translations.literal: ○ Four Seas Measurement and Testing
translations.idiomatic: ○ Observations at the Four Seas

sentences.zh: 南海，北極出地一十五度，夏至景在表南，長一尺一寸六分，晝五十四刻，夜四十六刻。

translations.literal: Southern Sea: north pole emerges from earth fifteen degrees; summer solstice shadow at the gnomon's south, long one chi one cun six fen; daytime fifty-four ke, night forty-six ke.
translations.idiomatic: At the Southern Sea station, the north celestial pole stands fifteen degrees above the horizon; at the summer solstice the shadow falls south of the gnomon, one chi one cun and six fen in length; the day lasts fifty-four ke and the night forty-six ke.

sentences.zh: 衡嶽，北極出地二十五度，夏至日在表端，無景，晝五十六刻，夜四十四刻。

translations.literal: Heng Yue: north pole emerges from earth twenty-five degrees; summer solstice sun at the gnomon's end, no shadow; daytime fifty-six ke, night forty-four ke.
translations.idiomatic: At Mount Heng, the north celestial pole stands twenty-five degrees above the horizon; at the summer solstice the sun stands directly over the gnomon and casts no shadow; the day lasts fifty-six ke and the night forty-four ke.
