sentences.zh: 嶽臺，北極出地三十五度，夏至晷景長一尺四寸八分，晝六十刻，夜四十刻。

translations.idiomatic: At the Yue Terrace observatory, the north celestial pole stands thirty-five degrees above the horizon; at the summer solstice the noon shadow is one chi four cun and eight fen long; the day lasts sixty ke and the night forty ke.

sentences.zh: 和林，北極出地四十五度，夏至晷景長三尺二寸四分，晝六十四刻，夜三十六刻。

translations.literal: Karakorum: north pole emerges from earth forty-five degrees; summer solstice gnomon shadow long three chi two cun four fen; daytime sixty-four ke, night thirty-six ke.
translations.idiomatic: At Karakorum, the north celestial pole stands forty-five degrees above the horizon; at the summer solstice the noon shadow is three chi two cun and four fen long; the day lasts sixty-four ke and the night thirty-six ke.

sentences.zh: 鐵勒，北極出地五十五度，夏至晷景長五尺一分，晝七十刻，夜三十刻。

translations.literal: Tiele: north pole emerges from earth fifty-five degrees; summer solstice gnomon shadow long five chi one fen; daytime seventy ke, night thirty ke.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tiele region, the north celestial pole stands fifty-five degrees above the horizon; at the summer solstice the noon shadow is five chi and one fen long; the day lasts seventy ke and the night thirty ke.

sentences.zh: 北海，北極出地六十五度，夏至晷景長六尺七寸八分，晝八十二刻，夜一十八刻。

translations.literal: Northern Sea: north pole emerges from earth sixty-five degrees; summer solstice gnomon shadow long six chi seven cun eight fen; daytime eighty-two ke, night eighteen ke.
translations.idiomatic: At the Northern Sea station, the north celestial pole stands sixty-five degrees above the horizon; at the summer solstice the noon shadow is six chi seven cun and eight fen long; the day lasts eighty-two ke and the night eighteen ke.

sentences.zh: 大都，北極出地四十度太強，夏至晷景長一丈二尺三寸六分，晝六十二刻，夜三十八刻。

translations.literal: Dadu: north pole emerges from earth forty degrees, strong excess; summer solstice gnomon shadow long one zhang two chi three cun six fen; daytime sixty-two ke, night thirty-eight ke.
translations.idiomatic: At Dadu, the north celestial pole stands a little more than forty degrees above the horizon; at the summer solstice the noon shadow is one zhang two chi three cun and six fen long; the day lasts sixty-two ke and the night thirty-eight ke.

translations.idiomatic: ○ Solar Eclipses, Halos, Parhelia, and Solar Phenomena

translations.idiomatic: On the first day (renxu) of the third month in the second year of Zhongtong, during the reign of Shizu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 三年十一月辛丑，日有背氣，重暈三珥。

translations.literal: Year 3, eleventh month, xinchou—sun had backing vapor; double halo, three mock suns.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the third year, on the day xinchou, counter-sun vapor appeared around the sun, with a double halo and three parhelia.

translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-fourth year of Zhiyuan, on the day guichou, the sun was ringed with interlocking halos, and a white rainbow pierced through it.

translations.literal: Tenth month, wuwu new moon—sun had eating.

translations.idiomatic: On the first day (jiawu) of the first month in the twenty-ninth year of Zhiyuan, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 有物漸侵入日中，不能既，日體如金環然，左右有珥，上有抱氣。

translations.literal: There was a thing gradually invading and entering within the sun; could not reach totality; the sun's body was like a gold ring; left and right had mock suns; above had embracing vapor.
translations.idiomatic: Something gradually encroached upon the sun without covering it entirely; the solar disk appeared like a gold ring, with parhelia to left and right and embracing vapor above.

translations.literal: Year 2, second month, renzi—White Metal day-seen.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year of Zhishun, on the day renzi, Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子朔，熒惑犯鬼宿。

translations.literal: Third month, bingzi new moon—Sparkling Deluder violated Ghost asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day, bingzi, of the third month in the second year of Zhishun, Mars encroached upon the Ghost asterism.

sentences.zh: 己卯，熒惑犯鬼宿積屍氣。

translations.literal: Jimao—Sparkling Deluder violated Accumulated Corpse Breath of Ghost asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao, Mars encroached upon the Accumulated Corpse Breath of the Ghost asterism.

sentences.zh: 五月丁丑，熒惑犯軒轅左角。

translations.literal: Fifth month, dingchou—Sparkling Deluder violated left horn of Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the second year of Zhishun, on the day dingchou, Mars encroached upon the left horn of the Chariot.

translations.literal: Jiawu—White Metal violated Net asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu, Venus encroached upon the Net asterism.

translations.literal: Gengzi—Great Yin violated White Metal.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, the moon encroached upon Venus.

translations.literal: Xinchou—White Metal crossed heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou, Venus crossed the sky.

translations.literal: Sixth month, dingwei—White Metal day-seen.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of Zhishun, on the day dingwei, Venus was seen in daylight.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太陰犯畢，太白犯井。

translations.literal: Dingmao—Great Yin violated Net; White Metal violated Well.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao, the moon encroached upon the Net; Venus encroached upon the Well.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，太白犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: Eighth month, yimao—White Metal violated great star of Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of Zhishun, on the day yimao, Venus encroached upon the great star of the Chariot.

translations.literal: Gengshen—White Metal violated left horn of Chariot.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen, Venus encroached upon the left horn of the Chariot.

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingzi—White Metal violated Fill Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the second year of Zhishun, on the day bingzi, Venus encroached upon Saturn.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申朔，太白犯鉤鈐。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renshen new moon—White Metal violated Hook and Winch.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day, renshen, of the eleventh month in the second year of Zhishun, Venus encroached upon the Hook and Winch.

sentences.zh: 三年五月癸酉，熒惑犯東井。

translations.literal: Year 3, fifth month, guiyou—Sparkling Deluder violated Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year of Zhishun, on the day guiyou, Mars encroached upon the Eastern Well.
